title: C lichen_rpl_dodag_process_dio_bytes does not compile
description: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/dodag.c lichen_rpl_dodag_process_dio_bytes (not in rpl_dodag.h) writes d->is_gateway_centric, which is not a member of struct lichen_rpl_dodag (the field is gateway_centric). It also calls lichen_rpl_dodag_process_dio with 6 arguments; the declaration requires 8 (config and authenticated are missing). Host compile of the full TU fails with those 3 errors. Discovered while adding a LICHEN_RPL_TEST-only lollipop host test that therefore compiles only the comparison helpers. Out of scope for worker6-y4yy (version_is_newer only).
close_reason: Fixed C compile of lichen_rpl_dodag_process_dio_bytes: write gateway_centric via process_dio (not is_gateway_centric), pass config+authenticated (8-arg), declare in rpl_dodag.h. Host cc -c of full TU succeeded; rpl_dodag lollipop test passed.
